welcome.label: Welcome · the empty seed heads

parts.label: 🗂 The case question
parts.title: The Empty Seed Heads
parts.body: Why were Pot B’s flower heads almost empty of seeds?

welcome.script:
Welcome back! We solved part one: same parent, different gardens. But the case isn’t over.

[ON SCREEN: Pot A · Pot B]
Dr. Reyes opened the dry flower heads. Pot A’s were packed with seeds. Pot B’s were almost empty. Hmm. And she says she hardly ever sees bees in that shady courtyard. I wonder if that matters.

[ON SCREEN: The case question]
That’s our case. Find four clues today. Press Listen on Dr. Reyes’s walkie-talkie, right below me.

warmup.label: Warm-Up · pollen pass (Clue 1)

parts.label: 💛 Pollen
parts.title: Pollen pass
rows: The bee starts dusty with pollen
Fly it to another beach sunflower

warmup.script:
[ON SCREEN: The bee]
Look at this little bee on a beach sunflower. See the yellow dust? (Rub your fingers together.) That’s pollen, and it sticks to the bee’s fuzzy body.

[ON SCREEN: Pollen]
In Pollen pass, you are the bee. Fly to another beach sunflower and the pollen rubs off. But be careful: two flowers are look-alikes. Then answer: what is that yellow powder for?

Press Listen for Dr. Reyes first.

vocab.label: Word Wall
vocab.script:
[ON SCREEN: Pollination]
Pollination is pollen moving to a flower. (Fly a pretend bee with your hand.)

[ON SCREEN: Germination]
Germination is a seed starting to grow. (Pop your fist open like a sprout.)

Tap each word below me to hear it.

part1.label: Part 1 · the bag test (Clue 2)
part1.script:
[ON SCREEN: One head]
Here’s something surprising. This sunflower head isn’t one flower. It’s hundreds of tiny flowers packed together, and each one can make one seed.

[ON SCREEN: The test]
Dr. Reyes tied mesh bags on some heads. Air and sun get in, but bees can’t. Everything else stays the same. That’s a fair test: only ONE thing changes.

You choose which heads get bags, then count the seeds. Press Listen on the walkie-talkie.

part2.label: Part 2 · put the cycle in order (Clue 3)
part2.script:
[ON SCREEN: Five steps]
Five steps make a new plant. Put them in order. Here’s a tip: what has to happen before a seed can even exist?

explore.label: Part 4 · seed travelers (Clue 4)
explore.script:
(Pretend to pull something off your sock.) Have you ever found sticky little seeds stuck to your socks after a walk? Those seeds were hitchhiking!

[ON SCREEN: Five ways]
Seeds can’t walk, but they travel five ways: wind, water, hitchhiking, inside an animal that eats them, or falling and getting buried. Read each Florida seed card and sort it. Look for clues like wings, hooks or berries.

Press Listen on the walkie-talkie.

quiz.label: Self-Check
quiz.script: Quick check: three questions, one at a time. It’s not graded. If you miss one, read the hint and try again.

assignment.label: Assignment · crack the case

parts.label: 🔓 Crack the case
parts.title: What happened to Pot B?
parts.body: Pick the answer that fits all four clues.

assignment.script:
[ON SCREEN: Crack the case]
You made it! First, crack the case at the top. Still locked? Tap “Show me where the clues are.”

[ON SCREEN: Your case report]
Then three parts. Part B: two short answers. Part C: pick one Florida flower and write one sentence for each of the five steps. A sketch is a bonus. Last, your CER.

Press Listen on the walkie-talkie.

partc.label: Part C · follow one flower
partc.script:
[ON SCREEN: One flower]
Pick one Florida flower, maybe a beach sunflower or an orange blossom. Write one sentence for each step, from pollen all the way to a new sprout.

evidence.label: Use your evidence · CER

parts.label: 💬 The quote
parts.title: A classmate says…
parts.body: “Flowers are just for looking pretty. They don’t really matter to the plant.”

parts.label: ⚖ CER
parts.title: Claim · Evidence · Reasoning
rows: Claim: what you think is true.
Evidence: facts from the lesson that prove it.
Reasoning: how the facts prove your claim.

evidence.script:
[ON SCREEN: The quote]
A classmate says flowers are just for looking pretty. Hmm.

Think back to the bag test. What happened to the heads the bees couldn’t reach? Could a plant make seeds without its flowers?

[ON SCREEN: CER]
Pick your side in the planner, tap two pieces of evidence, then write your reasoning in your own words. Try starting with “This shows that…”

Press Listen for Dr. Reyes.

closing.label: Case closed

parts.label: 🕸 Your specimen
parts.title: Mesh pollinator bag
parts.body: Finish the checklist to stamp CASE CLOSED.

parts.label: ➡ Next week
parts.title: Circle of life
parts.body: Follow Florida plants and animals through their whole lives, and through the seasons.

closing.script:
[ON SCREEN: Confetti]
Case closed! No bees, no pollen moving, no seeds. Pollination comes first.

[ON SCREEN: Your specimen]
Check every box in What to Turn In, and a mesh pollinator bag goes into your Field Notebook.

[ON SCREEN: Next week]
Next week, we’ll follow Florida plants and animals through their whole lives.

Press Listen for Dr. Reyes’s last word.

vr.label: VR activity · Seed to seed (separate page)

parts.label: ✉️ The seed envelope
parts.title: Can you grow these into new seeds?
parts.body: Dr. Reyes saved Pot A’s seeds. She wants proof you know the whole circle, from seed to seed.

parts.label: 🧭 Two ways
parts.title: Two ways to do it
rows: VR Field Mission: grow a sunflower circle and a pumpkin circle in Farm Town.
No headset? Follow a watermelon, a pumpkin and a tomato from flower to seed.

parts.label: 🥇 The badge
parts.title: Golden Seed badge
parts.body: Save your capture in VR to earn it.

vr.script:
Hi, scientists! Dr. Reyes saved some of Pot A’s seeds, and she has a question.

[ON SCREEN: The seed envelope]
Can you grow these into NEW seeds? Show her the whole circle.

[ON SCREEN: Two ways]
Pick your way at the top. With a headset, grow two full circles in Farm Town: seeds, four stages, and a bee to close the ring. Then tell each story out loud.

[ON SCREEN: A baby watermelon]
No headset? Watch three flowers turn into fruit. See this tiny bump behind the flower? That’s a baby watermelon!

[ON SCREEN: The badge]
Finish in VR to earn the Golden Seed badge!

Press Listen on Dr. Reyes’s walkie-talkie, right below me.
